main_body: Seamless snow ground patch: pale blue-white snow with dark grey-green clumps (shrub/rock-like speckle) in a repeating tile pattern; a flat terrain surface
top_band: none - flat ground terrain texture, no standing object with a top and front face
evidence: This is a terrain ground tile, not a standing object. The scan shows repeating vertical runs of snow tones and dark clumps, with no top/front structure to judge. No side faces, no elevation drawing. The 3/4 contract does not apply to flat ground, so it passes.

style.evidence: Candidate has 8 distinct colours and a median of 8 per tile, far below the grass reference (80 colours, 26 per tile) but comparable to the paving reference (7 colours, 7 per tile). Flat-fill coverage is 0%, and dark pixels are tinted (0% neutral), so the dark clumps lean green-grey rather than black. Shading uses about 5 lightness steps (white, pale blue, light grey-green, mid grey-green, dark grey-green) with dithered speckle in the dark clumps and highlight dots in the snow. The pattern is a clearly repeating motif, but it reads as snow with clumps and is cleanly dithered. It is thinner than the grass reference, but it matches the paving reference in richness and carries texture across the whole tile, so it is acceptable beside the references.
